# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 09 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market: Volume Up, Prices Softer

- **HDB resale transactions hit 2026 high in July as prices continue to fall** - Singapore's HDB resale market recorded 2,660 transactions in July, the highest monthly volume so far in 2026, while the resale price index continued to soften and now sits 0.7% below its level a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-2026-high-in-july-as-prices-continue-to-fall/)

- **S$1.65M Bishan maisonette becomes Singapore's priciest executive flat on record** - A high-floor executive maisonette in Bishan changed hands for S$1.65 million on 4 August 2026, setting a new record as both the highest-priced HDB resale flat in Bishan and Singapore's most expensive executive flat ever sold. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/s1-65m-bishan-maisonette-becomes-singapores-priciest-executive-flat-to-date/)

## En Bloc Reform: Lower Consent Thresholds Proposed for Older Condos

- **Parliament introduces bill to lower en bloc consent thresholds for ageing developments** - The Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026, introduced in Parliament on 4 August, proposes reducing the owner consent required for a collective sale to 70% for developments aged 40–59 years, down from the current 80%. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/proposed-en-bloc-consent-thresholds/)

- **Proposed reforms would cut thresholds further for condos aged 60 and above** - Under the same proposed reforms, developments 60 years or older would need only 65% owner consent for a collective sale, compared with the current 80% threshold that applies across the board. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-proposal-revive-en-bloc-hopes-for-older-condos/)

- **Lakeside Towers launches third en bloc attempt at $350 million reserve price** - The 45-year-old Lakeside Towers has relaunched its collective sale tender for the third time with the reserve price unchanged at $350 million, after previous attempts in 2018, 2022, and 2023 did not find a buyer. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/this-45-year-old-condo-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-350-million-price-tag/)

## Infrastructure & New Launches

- **Cross Island Line Phase 3 to add four stations extending west to Gul Circle** - Announced on 31 July 2026, CRL Phase 3 will add four new stations and extend the line by approximately 10km from the future Jurong Lake District station to Gul Circle. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/cross-island-line-phase-3/)

- **Bukit Sembawang launches Phase 10 of Luxus Hills Collection in Seletar Hills** - The new phase features five-bedroom terrace houses on 999-year leasehold land, with private lifts, rooftop solar panels, and EV-ready provisions. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/toured-a-new-collection-of-999-year-landed-homes-seletar/)
